evidence_quotes: Vovo last onder dwangsom lozingen afvalwater met PFOA en FRD-903 op gemeentelijk riool.
rationale: Dutch administrative preliminary injunction (voorlopige voorziening) concerning an order subject to penalty (last onder dwangsom) over discharges of wastewater containing chemical pollutants PFOA and FRD-903 into the municipal sewer system. Substantively concerns wastewater governance and industrial effluent pollution control.
